tip
Demons are called out with Chaos Bolt (Touch of Rancora). As Diabolist, always spend Soul Shards on Chaos Bolt regardless of target count (Wowhead)
tip

After Demonic Art: Mother of Chaos, Incinerate becomes Infernal Bolt (generates 3 Soul Shards), so drop to 2 shards or fewer before casting it. After Demonic Art: Pit Lord, Chaos Bolt becomes Ruination, so aim it at the biggest pack
tip
Enemies hit by Demonic Art: Overlord take 5% more damage from you for 15 seconds via Cloven Souls. Aim it at the big pack
tip
Summon Infernal is 1 min 30 sec with Inferno. Your stun is Shadowfury (45 sec)
tip
Apply Wither instead of Immolate. In AoE, put Wither on every long-lived enemy, then activate Malevolence (1 min) (Wowhead)
tip
Use every cooldown and spend as many Soul Shards as possible during the 20 seconds of Malevolence. Blackened Soul makes Wither stacks burst for damage
tip
Spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire at 3+ targets and on Chaos Bolt at 1-2 targets (Wowhead)
tip
No Shadowfury stun, but you get the AoE fear Howl of Terror (35 sec). Curse of Tongues is also only in this build
tip

Summon Infernal · 2 min (1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) · 30 seconds of nearby AoE damage and Soul Shard fragment generation, 2-second stun where it lands. Rain of Chaos adds extra Infernals
tip
Malevolence · 1 min · 20 sec (Hellcaller) · Damages every enemy with Wither, +6 stacks, 8% Haste
tip
Cataclysm · 30 sec · 8-yard AoE damage and applies Immolate; Lake of Fire leaves a 10-second ground effect
tb
Unending Resolve · 3 min · 40% damage reduction for 8 seconds (Strength of Will), immune to interrupts and silence
tb
Dark Pact · 1 min · Sacrifice 20% of current health for a 20-second shield worth 200% of that (+ spell power bonus). Usable while crowd controlled
tb
Soul Leech · passive · Shield for 3% of single-target damage dealt (up to 20% of max health, including a talent shared by both builds)
tb
Healthstone · 1 min · Instantly heals 25% + 30% over 6 seconds (Empowered Healthstone)
tb
Mortal Coil · 45 sec · 3-second incapacitate on the target, heals you for 20% max health (Diabolist: +10 yards range, +5% healing)
int
Your interrupt is the Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec). Summon it with Summon Felhunter and use it via a Command Demon macro. You have no interrupt while the Imp is out
disp

Remove 1 magic effect from an ally with the Imp's Singe Magic (15 sec). You have to swap pets, so summon quickly with Fel Domination (3 min). Wowhead considers the swap worth it for Kystia and Twinfang Harrower packs
disp
The Felhunter's Devour Magic (15 sec) removes 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy (Healing Breeze, etc., Wowhead)
int
Slowing casts: Blight of Tongues (2 min, +100% cast time on enemies within 10 yards for 12 seconds). Hellcaller also has Curse of Tongues, which spreads within 10 yards with Foul Mouth
cc
AoE control: Diabolist Shadowfury (45 sec, 3-second stun within 8 yards), Hellcaller Howl of Terror (35 sec, fears 10 targets). Single target: Mortal Coil. Bosses are immune to all of them
tip
For a battle res, put Soulstone (10 min) on the healer in advance. Hand out Healthstones with Create Soulwell before the pull
tip

Movement: Demonic Circle / Demonic Circle: Teleport (30 sec, removes snares); teleporting with Soulburn active grants 6 seconds of snare and root immunity. Move the party with Demonic Gateway; turn Burning Rush on only briefly
cc
Ascendant week: stop grouped orbs with Shadowfury (Diabolist); in a pinch, handle one with Mortal Coil. It's less effective when they're spread out (Wowhead)
prio

disp

1244310.d:

1271699.d: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.

348.m: 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
348.d:
적을 불태워 즉시 (주문력의 93.5505%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 350.814%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

주기적인 피해를 입히면 50%의 확률로 영혼의 조각 파편 1개를 생성합니다. 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 추가로 1개를 더 생성합니다.

688.m: 영혼의 조각 1개 · 6 초 주문 시전 시간
688.d: 원거리에서 적을 불화살로 공격하는 임프를 소환하여 부립니다.

691.m: 영혼의 조각 1개 · 6 초 주문 시전 시간
691.d: 지옥사냥개를 소환하여 부리며 적의 마법 시전을 방해합니다.

710.m: 특성 · 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
710.d: 적 악마, 돌연변이 [상급 추방: 언데드] 또는 정령을 차원의 저편으로 추방합니다. 추방당한 대상은 30초 동안 어떠한 행동도 할 수 없습니다. 한 번에 하나의 대상으로 제한됩니다. 추방 주문을 대상에게 다시 시전하면 효과가 사라집니다.

1122.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1122.d:
뒤틀린 황천으로부터 지옥불정령을 소환하여 선택한 지역의 모든 적에게 (주문력의 60%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 2초 동안 기절시킵니다.

지옥불정령은 30초 동안 흑마법사와 함께 적을 공격하여 주위의 모든 적에게 2초마다 [(주문력의 55%) * (105) / 100]의 피해를 입히며, 1초마다 영혼의 조각 파편 1개를 생성합니다.

1714.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
1714.d:
악마어로 말하도록 대상을 강제하여 주문의 시전 시간을 30%만큼 지연시킵니다. 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

저주: 흑마법사마다 한 대상에 동시에 하나의 저주만 걸 수 있습니다.

5484.m: 특성 · 1.8% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 40 초 재사용 대기시간
5484.d: 끔찍하게 울부짖어 10미터 내의 적 5명을 공포에 질려 도망가게 하고, 20초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 피해를 받으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

5740.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 3개 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
5740.d:
대상 위치에 지옥불의 비를 불러 내려 해당 지역 내에 있는 적에게 8초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 59.6911%) * 8]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

이 주문은 선택된 위치에 시전됩니다.

6201.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 3 초 주문 시전 시간
6201.d: 생명석을 창조합니다. 생명석을 사용하면 25%의 생명력을 회복합니다.

6262.m: 아이템 효과 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
6262.d: 즉시 25%의 생명력을 회복하고, 6초에 걸쳐 추가로 30%만큼 생명력을 회복합니다.

6789.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
6789.d: 적이 두려움에 휩싸여 달아나게 만들어 3초 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만들고, 자신은 최대 생명력의 20%를 회복합니다.

17877.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 1개 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
17877.d:
적을 강타하여 (주문력의 496.8%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다. 생명력이 20% 미만인 대상에게만 사용할 수 있습니다.

5초 안에 대상이 사망할 경우 영혼의 조각 1개를 생성하고 재사용 대기시간이 사라집니다.

17962.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12.96 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
17962.d:
대상에게 폭발을 일으켜 (주문력의 359.309%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. [역류: 10초 동안 다음 소각 또는 혼돈의 화살의 시전 시간이 30%만큼 감소합니다]

영혼의 조각 파편 5개를 생성합니다.

19505.m: 기력 20 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
19505.d: 적에게서 1개의 이로운 마법 효과를 제거합니다. 마법이 제거되면 지옥사냥개의 생명력이 (주문력의 80%)만큼 회복되고 60의 지옥 마력을 얻습니다.

20707.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 3 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
20707.d: 대상 파티원 혹은 공격대원의 영혼이 보존되어 대상이 죽었을 때 부활할 수 있습니다. 대상은 60%의 생명력과 최소 20%의 마나를 지닌 채로 부활합니다.

29722.m: 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
29722.d:
적에게 불을 끌어들여 (주문력의 438.084%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

영혼의 조각 파편 2개를 생성합니다. 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 추가로 1개를 생성합니다.

29893.m: 5% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 3 초 주문 시전 시간 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
29893.d: 2분 동안 영혼의 샘을 창조합니다. 파티원과 공격대원이 영혼의 샘을 클릭하면 생명석을 얻을 수 있습니다.

30283.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 35 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
30283.d: 8미터 반경 내의 모든 적을 3초 동안 기절시킵니다.

48018.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 사정거리 없음 · 0.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
48018.d: 15분 동안 악마의 마법진을 소환합니다. 악마의 마법진: 순간이동을 시전하면 해당 지역으로 순간이동하고 모든 이동 속도 감소 효과를 제거합니다.

48020.m: 3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
48020.d: 악마의 마법진으로 순간이동하며 모든 이동 속도 감소 효과를 제거합니다.

89808.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
89808.d:
해로운 주문을 불태워 아군 대상으로부터 1개의 해로운 마법 효과를 제거합니다.

자동 시전:
주인이 마법 효과 때문에 주문을 시전할 수 없을 때 주인에게 사용합니다.

(마우스 오른쪽 클릭으로 사용 / 미사용)

104773.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간
104773.d: 피부를 단단하게 만들어 8초 동안 받는 모든 피해를 25%만큼 감소시키고, 주문 방해 및 침묵 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

108416.d: 현재 생명력의 20%만큼을 희생시켜, 20초 동안 희생한 생명력의 200%만큼 피해를 흡수하고 추가로 (주문력 * 2.5)의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 자신에게 씌웁니다. 제어 방해 효과에 걸린 상태에서도 사용할 수 있습니다.

111400.d: 이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가하지만, 1초마다 최대 생명력의 4%에 해당하는 피해를 입습니다. 이동 방해 효과에 걸려도 이동 속도가 평상시의 100% 이하로 내려가지 않습니다. 활성화되어 있는 동안 지속됩니다.

111771.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 10 - 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
111771.d: 두 지점을 연결하는 악마의 관문을 생성합니다. 관문이 작동하면 사용자는 즉시 반대쪽 관문으로 전송됩니다. 플레이어마다 90초당 한 번씩만 악마의 관문을 사용할 수 있습니다.

116858.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 2개 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 3 초 주문 시전 시간
116858.d: 혼돈의 광선을 내뿜어 극대화 효과를 발휘하며 [2 * (주문력의 429.049%)]의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다. 자신의 극대화율에 따라 공격력이 추가로 증가합니다.

119898.d:
악마에게 명령을 내려 가장 강력한 능력을 사용하게 합니다. 이 주문은 현재 소환수에 따라 달라집니다.
[지옥수호병 소환: 지옥수호병: 도끼 던지기]
지옥사냥개: 주문 잠금
공허방랑자: 어둠의 보루
인큐버스/서큐버스: 유혹
임프: 마법 태우기

119910.d: 적의 주문 시전을 차단하여 7초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

152108.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
152108.d: 대상 지점에 대재앙을 만들어내 8미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게 (주문력의 364.5%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입히고 제물 효과를 부여합니다.

196406.d: 점화가 다음 소각, 영혼의 불꽃 또는 혼돈의 화살의 시전 시간을 30%만큼 감소시킵니다. 최대 [섬락: 4 / 2]회 충전됩니다.

196408.d: 소각이 대상 주위의 모든 적에게 적중하여 25%의 피해를 입힙니다.

266086.d: 첫 번째 지옥불정령이 활성화되어 있는 동안 영혼의 조각을 소모할 때마다 15%의 확률로 8초 동안 지속되는 지옥불정령을 추가로 소환합니다.

333889.d: 다음 임프, 공허방랑자, 인큐버스, 서큐버스, 지옥사냥개 또는 지옥수호병 소환이 자원을 소모하지 않으며 주문의 시전 시간이 90%초만큼 감소합니다.

334275.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
334275.d:
12초 동안 대상의 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

저주: 흑마법사는 한 대상에게 하나의 저주만 걸 수 있습니다.

385899.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 1개 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
385899.d:
영혼의 조각을 소모하여 주문의 잠재된 힘을 끌어냅니다.

악마의 마법진: 순간이동: 이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가하고 6초 동안 감속 및 이동 불가 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

악마의 관문: 즉시 시전됩니다.

생명력 흡수: 30초 동안 치유량과 같은 양의 피해 흡수 보호막을 얻습니다. 이 보호막은 최대 생명력의 30%를 초과할 수 없습니다.

생명석: 생명석의 치유량이 30%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 사용 시 12초 동안 최대 생명력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

387384.d:
치명타 및 극대화율이 2%만큼 증가합니다.

물리 공격을 받으면 20%의 확률로 다음 소각이 즉시 시전됩니다. 이 효과는 6초에 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

387506.d:
단일 대상 주문 시전 시 35%의 확률로 주위 적에게 5.0초 동안 대혼란을 부여합니다.

대혼란
5.0초 동안 대상에게 대혼란의 징표를 찍어, 단일 대상 공격 주문이 대혼란의 징표가 찍힌 대상도 함께 공격해 입힌 피해의 50%만큼 피해를 입힙니다. (5.1초 재사용 대기시간)

428514.d:
혼돈의 화살 또는 불의 비, 어둠의 연소 시전 시 20초 동안 악마의 의식이 부여됩니다. 악마의 의식이 이미 활성화된 상태라면 지속시간이 1초만큼 감소합니다.

악마의 의식이 만료되면 악마술이 부여되어 다음 혼돈의 화살, 불의 비, 또는 어둠의 연소 시전 시 대군주 또는 혼돈의 어머니, 지옥의 군주를 소환해 적에게 파멸적인 공격을 퍼붓게 합니다.

428517.d: 대군주에게 피해를 받은 적은 영혼이 쪼개져 15초 동안 시전자와 소환수에게 받는 피해가 5%만큼 증가합니다.

428524.d: 다음 영혼의 조각 소모 시 대군주를 소환하여 파괴적인 공격을 가하게 합니다.

429581.d: 지옥불정령 소환이 강화되어 40%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 지옥불정령 소환의 효과가 끝나면 50%의 효과를 발휘하는 두 개의 작은 지옥불정령으로 분열되어 10초 동안 지속됩니다.

429893.d:
악마술이 다음 혼돈의 화살, 불의 비 또는 어둠의 연소의 공격력을 20%만큼 증가시키고 시전 시간은 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

혼돈의 화살 시전 시 악마의 의식의 지속시간이 추가로 1초만큼 감소합니다.

432794.d: 다음 영혼의 조각 소모 시 혼돈의 어머니를 소환하여 파괴적인 공격을 가하게 합니다.

432795.d: 다음 영혼의 조각 소모 시 지옥의 군주를 소환하여 파괴적인 공격을 가하게 합니다.

433891.d:
혼돈의 어머니가 다음 소각을 강화하여 지옥불 화살로 전환시킵니다.

지옥불 화살
심연의 지옥불로 타오르는 화살을 날려 적 대상에게 (주문력의 1347.35%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 영혼의 조각 3개를 생성합니다.

434635.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
434635.d:
뒤틀린 황천의 심층부에서 악마가 깃든 운석을 불러 내립니다. 충격 지점 8미터 내의 모든 적에게 (주문력의 2537.91%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고 악독한 임프 1마리를 소환합니다.

치명타 및 극대화율에 따라 공격력이 추가로 증가하며, 8명을 넘는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다

440043.d:
대상에게 쇠퇴가 부여되어 있을 경우, 혼돈의 화살 및 어둠의 연소 시전 시 쇠퇴의 중첩이 1만큼 증가합니다.

쇠퇴의 중첩이 쌓일 때마다 일정 확률로 붕괴 작용을 일으켜 1초마다 중첩을 하나씩 소모해 (주문력의 144.468%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다. 대상에게 중첩이 하나만 남을 때까지 지속됩니다.

442726.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
442726.d:
20초 동안 암흑 마법을 방출해 영혼을 타락시킵니다. 이때 자신의 쇠퇴에 걸린 적은 (주문력의 1265.51%)의 암흑불길 피해를 받고 중첩이 6만큼 증가합니다.

타락한 동안 가속이 8%만큼 증가하고 공격 주문으로 영혼의 조각을 소모하면 쇠퇴 1중첩을 추가로 부여합니다.

445468.m: 특성 · 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
445468.d:
대상에게 흉악한 저주를 내려 힘줄과 근육을 살라 먹게 합니다. 즉시 (주문력의 24.7969%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입히고 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 370.679%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다.

주기적인 피해를 입히면 영혼의 조각 파편 1개를 생성하고 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 50%의 확률로 추가로 1개를 생성합니다.

제물을 대체합니다.

454744.d: 화염 주문의 공격력이 2%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 소각 주문의 시전 시간이 20%만큼 감소합니다.

1244310.d:
점화의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

점화 시전 시 대상의 제물을 터뜨려 최대 3명의 주위 적에게 전이시킵니다.

1244877.d:
대재앙 시전 시 불의 호수를 남겨 안에 있는 적에게 10초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 60%) * 10]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

제물 시전 시 불의 호수 안에 있는 적에게 20%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

1244941.d: 불의 비 시전 시 20%의 확률로 다음 8초 안에 시전하는 불의 비의 자원 소모량이 100%만큼 감소합니다.

1265774.d:
혼돈의 화살, 어둠의 연소 또는 불의 비를 시전하면 각각 50%, 50% 또는 60%의 효율로 암흑 티탄의 힘이 남긴 메아리를 일깨웁니다.

대상이 없으면 시전자의 제물에 걸린 무작위 대상이 선택됩니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1265813.d: 피로의 저주, 언어의 저주 또는 무력화 저주 시전 시 대상 10미터 내의 모든 적에게 저주를 겁니다.

1271699.d: 생명석 사용 시 5%의 생명력을 추가로 회복합니다.

1271802.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1271802.d:
엉겨 붙는 어둠의 안개구름을 불러내 대상과 10미터 내 모든 적을 감쌉니다. 감싸인 대상은 12초 동안 모든 주문의 시전 속도가 100%만큼 감소합니다.

저주: 흑마법사는 대상 하나당 단 하나의 저주 또는 역병을 걸 수 있습니다.

1280483.d: 지옥불정령 소환의 재사용 대기시간이 30.0초만큼 감소하고 특화는 3%만큼 증가합니다.

1311653.d: 자신과 하수인이 입히는 단일 대상 피해가 흑마법사와 소환수에게 어둠의 보호막을 부여하여, 15초 동안 입힌 피해의 3%에 해당하는 피해를 흡수합니다. 최대 생명력의 5 / 악마의 피부: 10 / 일후프의 간계: 20 / 경화된 영혼: 10%까지 피해를 흡수합니다.

317138.d: 영원한 결의 사용 시 받는 피해가 15%만큼 추가로 감소합니다.

386689.d:
직접 창조하는 생명석이 전투 중 여러 번 사용 가능한 악마의 생명석이 됩니다. 악마의 생명석은 거래가 불가능합니다.

악마의 생명석
즉시 25%의 생명력을 회복합니다. [강화된 생명석: 추가로 6초에 걸쳐 30%의 생명력을 회복합니다] 60초의 재사용 대기시간이 적용됩니다.

428911.d: 악마의 마법진: 순간이동 시전 시 항상 영혼 불사르기의 이로운 효과를 받고 이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 6초 동안 이동 속도 감소 및 이동 불가 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

1270255.d:
어둠의 격노의 재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소하고 반경은 2미터만큼 증가합니다.

공포의 울부짖음의 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소하고, 추가 적 5명을 공포에 질리게 합니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two kick spots that make Radiant Spellsower walk to the tank with your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec). Spell Lock stops Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy) and locks Holy spells for 7 sec, so Light Bolt is blocked as well.

[제어] When a low-health Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, slow it with Curse of Exhaustion (50% movement speed for 12 sec). Break the Frantic Blooming channel with Shadowfury (45 sec with Oppressive Darkness, 3 sec stun in 10 yd) in the Diabolist build, or Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate) in the Hellcaller build.

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out once everything is stacked (Topicx). Drop Summon Infernal (1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) and Cataclysm (30 sec) into the pack with it, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence (1 min). Use Dark Pact (45 sec for Diabolist with Frequent Donor, 1 min for Hellcaller) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [차단] Decide before the pull which of the two Radiant Spellsowers Spell Lock covers. If both cast Light Bolt Volley together next to the tank, stun both with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build, or stop both with Howl of Terror (35 sec with Oppressive Darkness) in the Hellcaller build.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher with the Lightbloom Pollination shield (600108 absorb) is immune to crowd control, so do not use Shadowfury or Mortal Coil on it. Pour Chaos Bolt and Conflagrate into that Lasher to break the shield first.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact you used on pull 1 is not back, use a Healthstone for Spouting Floret. With Pact of Gluttony, your own Healthstone can be reused every 1 min even in combat.
3: [광역 피해] When the 12 Lashers stack on the tank, drop Cataclysm (30 sec) and use Summon Infernal here if it is back. Spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire in the Hellcaller build and on Chaos Bolt in the Diabolist build, and as Diabolist drop Ruination from Demonic Art: Pit Lord on this pack if it is up.

[제어] When the two Radiant Spellsowers flee with Call The Grove, curse them with Curse of Exhaustion. Foul Mouth spreads it to enemies within 10 yd of the target, so one cast slows both if they are together.
5: [차단] Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec party disorient) is a long cast that one ranged player can cover alone (Topicx). Cover it with Spell Lock (24 sec).

[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal and knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec), stop it with a stun (Topicx). Stun it with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build, and stop it with Mortal Coil in the Hellcaller build, which has no Shadowfury.

[광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first and Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later (Topicx), so use Summon Infernal and Cataclysm after the Grovekeeper is stacked. Use Dark Pact for the Spouting Floret of the Belcher that arrives first.
7: [차단] Stop Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Spell Lock. Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) hits a random target, so kick it only when Spell Lock is available.

[제어] When the two Thorny Saptors start Thornclaw Leap, stun both with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build if they are within 10 yd of each other. In the Hellcaller build, stop one with Mortal Coil and leave the other cone with a short Burning Rush.

[광역 피해] Most of this pull's count is the two Luminous Thornmaws (22 each). Drop Summon Infernal between them, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to both Thornmaws and line up Malevolence with this pull.
8: [차단] Stop one of the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot with Spell Lock.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build and with Mortal Coil in the Hellcaller build.
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and top yourself up with a Healthstone if Dark Pact is not ready.
10: [광역 피해] Warlocks cannot remove Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew poison (58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec), so hold Dark Pact through the poison damage.

[우선 처치] Clear the adds first, then move to Potatoad Matriarch (Topicx). Break the Pollination shields of the two Lightgorged Lashers with Chaos Bolt first, and line up Summon Infernal with the Matriarch (60 count).
11: [차단] The three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech is a long cast that is easy to kick (Topicx). Spell Lock covers one of them, and if all three cast together, stop them with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build or Howl of Terror in the Hellcaller build.

[광역 피해] Spouting Floret and Screech overlap in this busy pull (Topicx). Use Dark Pact for Spouting Floret, and Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will) if Dark Pact is not ready.
12: [차단] Decide which of the two Radiant Spellsowers Spell Lock covers. Kicking Light Bolt Volley locks its Holy spells for 7 sec, so that Spellsower walks to the tank.

[우선 처치] The six Lightgorged Lashers become immune to crowd control once their Lightbloom Pollination shields are up. Line up Summon Infernal, Cataclysm, and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build with this pull to break the shields together.
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. If you used Dark Pact on pull 11, use Unending Resolve instead.

1: [차단] Each Primal Serpent needs its own kicker, so take one Serpent's Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec).

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws and the tank starts taking heavy damage, stun the pack with Shadowfury (45 sec, 3 sec stun in 10 yd) in the Diabolist build to drop the 2 sec stacks. The Hellcaller build drops Summon Infernal in the middle of the pack and breaks the stacks with its 2 sec stun.

[해제] Wowhead considers swapping to the Imp worthwhile on Twinfang Harrower packs to remove Paralyzing Shots (Magic, 48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec) with Singe Magic (15 sec). This pull also brings two Serpents whose Piercing Hiss must be kicked, so summon the Imp quickly with Fel Domination (3 min) only if two other players can kick.
2: [우선 처치] Focus Chaos Bolt on the Ritual Chieftain. In the Hellcaller build, apply Wither to the Chieftain first and then press Malevolence (1 min). Kick the remaining Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Spell Lock.

[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact (45 sec for Diabolist with Frequent Donor, 1 min for Hellcaller) for Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb). The shield absorbs Physical damage as well.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, put Blight of Tongues (2 min, 100% longer cast times for enemies within 10 yd for 12 sec) on them to stretch Piercing Hiss to an 8 sec cast. Wowhead recommends Blight of Tongues on this dungeon's caster packs. Kick one of the three with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact used on pull 2 is not back, use a Healthstone for Blood Sacrifice. With Pact of Gluttony, your own Healthstone can be reused every 1 min even in combat.
4: [우선 처치] Line up Chaos Bolt and Cataclysm (30 sec) on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land. Take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for Blood Sacrifice, and top yourself up with a Healthstone if Dark Pact is not ready.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Drop Summon Infernal (1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) and Cataclysm into the pack, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence. Spend Soul Shards on melting the Ritual Chieftain first.

[광역 피해] When Blood Sacrifice's Physical damage overlaps with the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots Nature DoTs, use Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will). Save Dark Pact for the next Blood Sacrifice.
[차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Spell Lock.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast, Nature) with Spell Lock. Nature spells stay locked for 7 sec, which also blocks the following Envenom, so use this kick on the Envenom right before Rattle that Topicx says must be stopped.

[제어] In the Diabolist build, break Evolve (6 sec channel) with a Shadowfury stun. The same stun also stops the three Bloodletters' melee swings and delays the blood pools. In the Hellcaller build, break Evolve with Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec).
8: [제어] When the four Bloodletters leave blood pools while hitting the tank, stun them all with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build. In the Hellcaller build, stop their melee with Howl of Terror (35 sec with Oppressive Darkness, fears up to 10 enemies within 10 yd), though damage may break it.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact used on pull 7 is not back, use a Healthstone for Rattle.
9: [차단] Topicx says one ranged player should take the kick on the High Evolutionist left far to the left and bring it in. Spell Lock has unlimited range, so take this Evolutionist and kick its Mass Envenom to make it walk to the pack. Waiting behind line of sight also brings it in (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Focus Chaos Bolt on the two High Evolutionists and kill them before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] When the four High Evolutionists group up, stretch all their cast times with Blight of Tongues and kick your assigned one's Mass Envenom with Spell Lock. Blight of Tongues counts as a curse, so the Hellcaller build applies Curse of Tongues (spread to 10 yd by Foul Mouth) only after Blight falls off.
[제어] When several channel Evolve together, stop them at once with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build or Howl of Terror in the Hellcaller build.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Summon Infernal on this mini-boss, and Malevolence as well in the Hellcaller build.
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), use Dark Pact.
13: [우선 처치] Focus Chaos Bolt on Ula'tek's Chosen and do not pour Cataclysm or Rain of Fire into the six Living Venoms at once. In the Hellcaller build, keep Wither off the Living Venoms so Malevolence does not burst them together.
[차단] Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Spell Lock for the Chosen.

[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and during it stun the two Blades of the Altar with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build to stop the Laced Edge teleports. The Hellcaller build holds one with Mortal Coil.
14: [광역 피해] If the Dark Pact used on pull 13 is not back, use Unending Resolve for Toxic Surge.
[차단] Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Spell Lock, and do not dump AoE cooldowns into the Living Venoms at once.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Spell Lock. If the two stand together, slow both casts with Blight of Tongues.
[제어] In the Diabolist build, stun the four Blades of the Altar together with Shadowfury.
16: [우선 처치] Line up Summon Infernal, Cataclysm and, in the Hellcaller build, Malevolence with this pull to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Spell Lock.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back and overlap with Toxic Surge (Topicx). Use Dark Pact for the first Blood Sacrifice and Unending Resolve for the second, and survive on a Healthstone if both are down.

1: [광역 피해] This Bloodlust pull brings Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together (Topicx). Drop Summon Infernal (1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) and Cataclysm (30 sec) with Bloodlust, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence (1 min). Spend Soul Shards on the Captain, which dies first.

[제어] When the two Street Sneaks coat their weapons with Heartstop Poison (8 sec), stun them with Shadowfury (45 sec, 3 sec stun in 10 yd) in the Diabolist build to slow the tank's poison stacks. Warlocks cannot remove this poison.

[광역 피해] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleed (155172 Bleed over 8 sec) overlaps with other debuffs, use a Healthstone. With Pact of Gluttony, your own Healthstone can be reused every 1 min even in combat.
2: [차단] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) needs one kicker per Sayaad (Topicx). Take one with your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec).

[제어] If the two Sayaads pulled out by line of sight stand together, stun both with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build to stop Seduction, and in the Hellcaller build stop the other one with Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
3: [차단] Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles (5 sec channel, Fire) is an optional kick. Use Spell Lock on Fel Missiles.
[광역 피해] Clear the six Felwyrms together by dropping Cataclysm into the pack. Fel Detonation on death only reaches 4 yd, so ranged can keep casting where they stand.
4: [제어] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks build fast (Topicx). When the Sneaks coat their weapons, stop their melee with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build or Howl of Terror (35 sec with Oppressive Darkness, fear in 10 yd) in the Hellcaller build.
5: [해제] Wowhead says Singe Magic can remove Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle (Magic). This pull's only kicks are the optional Fel Missiles, so summon the Imp quickly with Fel Domination (3 min) and remove Spittle with Singe Magic (15 sec).
[우선 처치] Massive Felwyrm is the priority target (Topicx). Pour Soul Shards and Conflagrate into it, and leave the Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire in 10 yd) range when it dies.
[광역 피해] When Over-infused's Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec) builds up, use Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will).
8: [차단] Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min) is an Enrage that warlocks cannot remove, so stop it with Spell Lock. Leave Fel Invoker's Health Funnel to another kicker.

[차단] Wowhead recommends Curse of Tongues and Foul Mouth on the later trash casters, especially imps. In the Hellcaller build, put Curse of Tongues on a Fel Invoker or Unleashed Imp to spread it within 10 yd; the Diabolist build uses Blight of Tongues (2 min, 100% longer cast times for 12 sec).
[광역 피해] Shivan Punisher deals Fire damage to the group below 50% until it dies (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build with the Punisher dropping below 50%.
9: [광역 피해] If you are targeted by Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life, use Unending Resolve. Without a defensive the enemy warlock heals a lot (Topicx). If Unending Resolve is down, heal 20% of max health with Mortal Coil and follow up with a Healthstone.
[차단] Stop one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] The eight Demon Flies are safe to gather (Topicx). Drop Cataclysm on them, and in the Hellcaller build spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (30 sec channel) with Spell Lock (Topicx).
[광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, drop Summon Infernal on the Punisher and the Demon Flies to end the Demonic Frenzy phase quickly.
11: [광역 피해] Kill Felmaster Lucsei fast so Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) does not come out more than three times (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build with Lucsei.
[광역 피해] Personal and group defensives are split across the Blade Dances (Topicx). Use Unending Resolve for the first Blade Dance and top yourself up with a Healthstone for the next.
13: [광역 피해] Use Unending Resolve for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone). This is when the group uses its defensives (Topicx).

[제어] When the six Unleashed Imps gather under the pack you brought over them, stun them with Shadowfury in the Diabolist build to delay Felfire Burst, and in the Hellcaller build spread Curse of Tongues with Foul Mouth. Drop Cataclysm on the imp pack.
[차단] Stop Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Spell Lock.
14: [차단] Stop Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Spell Lock and leave Fel Invoker's Health Funnel to another kicker. Put Blight of Tongues on the six Unleashed Imps to slow Felfire Burst.
[광역 피해] When the six imps gather on the tank, drop Cataclysm, and in the Hellcaller build spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire.
15: [광역 피해] If you are targeted by Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life, use Unending Resolve, or Mortal Coil and a Healthstone if you already used it. Topicx says to pull the Warlock back first and kill the Shivan Punisher separately.
[광역 피해] Line up Summon Infernal with the Punisher dropping below 50%, not with the Warlock, to end the Demonic Frenzy phase quickly.
16: [광역 피해] The Defiled Golem's AoE should end within two casts (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal, Cataclysm and, in the Hellcaller build, Malevolence on the Golem.
[광역 피해] Use Unending Resolve for the first Defiled Slam and a Healthstone for the second.
[차단] Kick one of the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel with Spell Lock.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust and cooldown pull (Topicx). Drop Summon Infernal (1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) and Cataclysm (30 sec) into the pack with it, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence (1 min).

[우선 처치] The Starvation Effigy totem must die before Insatiable Hunger's curse lands twice (Topicx). Switch to the totem as soon as it appears and break it with Conflagrate and Chaos Bolt. Warlocks cannot remove this curse.

[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact (45 sec for Diabolist with Frequent Donor, 1 min for Hellcaller) for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec). If Razor Dive bleeds are stacked on you, use a Healthstone as well.
2: [차단] Earthwhisper Tender's Earth Bolt and Healing Breeze both need kicks. Use your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec) on Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast), and purge the healing effect (Magic) of any Healing Breeze that goes through from the Tender with your Felhunter's Devour Magic (15 sec) (Wowhead).

[차단] Wowhead says Curse of Tongues is especially strong in this dungeon because of its many dangerous casters. In the Hellcaller build, keep Curse of Tongues (30% longer cast times for 1 min) on the Tender. The Diabolist build uses Blight of Tongues (2 min, 100% longer cast times for 12 sec).
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for the Feast of Misery channel.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Spell Lock, and purge any healing effect that goes through with Devour Magic.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact used on pull 2 is not back, use a Healthstone for Feast of Misery. With Pact of Gluttony, your own Healthstone can be reused every 1 min even in combat.
4: [광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for the Feast of Misery channel, and top yourself up with a Healthstone when the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) build up.
[우선 처치] When the Starvation Effigy totem appears, break it right away with Conflagrate to prevent a second Insatiable Hunger stack.
5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Spell Lock, and purge any healing effect that goes through with Devour Magic.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Once everything is gathered in the corner, use Summon Infernal and Cataclysm, and line up Malevolence in the Hellcaller build.

[차단] When the two Earthwhisper Tenders stand next to the tank, slow both casts with Blight of Tongues and take one Tender's Healing Breeze with Spell Lock. Purge any Healing Breeze that goes through with Devour Magic.
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield holds, it deals 24246 Nature to the whole group every 2 sec. Pour Chaos Bolt into the Rumbler to break the shield.
[광역 피해] If the shield holds for a long time, use Dark Pact to absorb Rumbling Ward's Nature damage.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Use Summon Infernal, Cataclysm and, in the Hellcaller build, Malevolence with it, and spend Soul Shards on breaking Terra Rumbler's shield first.
[차단] Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% less Haste and movement speed if it lands) is a long cast that is easy to kick (Topicx). Take one Mauler with Spell Lock.
10: [차단] Take one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar with Spell Lock, and if the two stand together, stretch both to a 7 sec cast with Blight of Tongues.

[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). If the Summon Infernal used on pull 9 is not back, line up Cataclysm (30 sec) and Malevolence (1 min) in the Hellcaller build with this pull.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first and Terra Rumbler next (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal on the Avatar if it is back, and pour Chaos Bolt into the Rumbler's shield after the Avatar.
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact when Rumbling Ward's Nature damage overlaps with Glacial Tomb's Frost damage. Pulverize (4 sec cast) stuns everything within 12 yd, so hit the Avatar from range.
13: [차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature to up to 3 players) with Spell Lock.

[광역 피해] Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking) is the ability to use defensives on in high keys (Topicx). Use Dark Pact for the first Echo and Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will) for the next.
[우선 처치] When Ruthless Totemcaller drops a Magma Totem, switch and break it right away with Conflagrate.
14: [우선 처치] Kill the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire to everyone every 0.3 sec) right away (Topicx). If the two totems stand together, hit both with Cataclysm.

[광역 피해] This is a candidate for the third Bloodlust (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes out here, line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build; if it is saved for Loa Speaker Nanea in high keys, save your cooldowns too.
[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Spell Lock.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns casting Primal Echo (Topicx). Use one defensive per Echo in the order Dark Pact, Unending Resolve, Healthstone.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Spell Lock, and break Magma Totems right away with Conflagrate.

[광역 피해] This is a big pull at 85 trash, so drop Summon Infernal and Cataclysm into the middle once the Warbringers are gathered, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence.
16: [차단] Kick Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt with Spell Lock. While Spell Lock is on cooldown, slow her casts with Blight of Tongues.

[우선 처치] The Volatile Totems should be finished by the second wave (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes out here in high keys, line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence, and drop Cataclysm between the totems when a wave appears. Hit the totems first unless Nanea is around 10% health.

1: [광역 피해] Pull the first corridor all the way to Voidtouched Magi and use Bloodlust (Topicx). Drop Summon Infernal (1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) and Cataclysm (30 sec) with it, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence (1 min).

[차단] One kicker per Shaman, and on the Magi's Shadowbolt Volley the tank takes the first kick and another player the second (Topicx). Take the Magi's second Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) with your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec). If casts need slowing, put Blight of Tongues (2 min, 100% longer cast times within 10 yd for 12 sec) on the Magi and the Shamans together.
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Null Eruption, leave the group and activate Dark Pact (45 sec for Diabolist with Frequent Donor, 1 min for Hellcaller) (Topicx).
2: [우선 처치] If even one of Raj'kess the Spellstorm's three Orb of Disruption orbs finishes its cast, the group loses a lot of Haste (Topicx). Switch to the orbs as soon as they appear and break them with Conflagrate and Shadowburn.

[광역 피해] Activate Dark Pact for the long Thundering Storm group damage, and use Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will) for the next one. Spread so Forked Lightning does not bounce.
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest room at 158 trash. When the packs from the left and right walls are gathered, use Summon Infernal and Cataclysm, and spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire in the Hellcaller build and on Chaos Bolt in the Diabolist build.
[광역 피해] Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec channel, 87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec) calls for personal defensives (Topicx). Activate Dark Pact, or Unending Resolve if you already used it.
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, it takes 20% more Physical damage and it is time to focus it (Topicx). Pour Chaos Bolt and Conflagrate into Brutok.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area (Topicx). Assign Spell Lock to the Screamer and leave Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt to another kicker.
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), leave the group, and activate Dark Pact in high keys (Topicx).
6: [우선 처치] Break Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield quickly with damage cooldowns (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal on the Overseer and press Malevolence in the Hellcaller build. Pour Soul Shards into the Overseer to kill it before its next shield.
[광역 피해] If you have to share Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike while Brutal Slams Physical damage is stacking, use Unending Resolve. The two overlapping wipes high keys (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) with Spell Lock.
8: [우선 처치] Every low-health mob (marked with an icon) that Devouring Brutalizer tries to eat with Devour (9 sec cast) must die right away (Topicx). Use Shadowburn and Conflagrate on that mob to kill it before the cast ends.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Spell Lock. Kick Voidminder's Mending Void only when you have room after the Devour target and the Screamer kick (Topicx).

[광역 피해] This is a damage cooldown pull (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build with this pull, and activate Dark Pact for Dreadbellow (knockback, 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [광역 피해] When the ten Scavenging Siphoids gather, drop Cataclysm on them, and in the Hellcaller build spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Spell Lock.

[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact used on pull 8 is not back, use Unending Resolve for Dreadbellow, and survive on a Healthstone if both are down. With Pact of Gluttony, your own Healthstone can be reused every 1 min even in combat.
10: [광역 피해] This 117-trash pull has both a Devouring Brutalizer and a Watchful Harrower. Line up Summon Infernal on the Brutalizer if it is back, and activate Dark Pact for Dreadbellow.
[차단] There is no Screamer in this pull, so use Spell Lock on Voidminder's Mending Void (20 sec healing channel).
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Void Beam, leave the group, and top yourself up with a Healthstone if Dark Pact is not ready.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon, so Bloodlust goes out (Topicx). Use Summon Infernal (2 min, 1 min 30 sec for Diabolist with Inferno) and Cataclysm (30 sec) with it, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence (1 min).

[광역 피해] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) needs a personal defensive on every cast (Topicx). Activate Dark Pact (45 sec for Diabolist with Frequent Donor, 1 min for Hellcaller) for the first cast and use Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will) for the next.

[해제] Minion of Zul on the way dies when its Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) is removed. Remove the shield with your Felhunter's Devour Magic (15 sec) to kill it (Wowhead). If several come at once, hold them with Shadowfury (Diabolist, 45 sec, 3 sec stun within 10 yd), and in the Hellcaller build hold one with Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec). In the Hellcaller build, put Curse of Tongues (30% longer cast times for 1 min) on the Hexer to slow its next cast (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Use Cataclysm and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build, and add Summon Infernal if it is back.
[광역 피해] For Shadow Whirlwind, use Dark Pact if the one from pull 1 is back, otherwise a Healthstone. With Pact of Gluttony, your own Healthstone can be reused every 1 min even in combat.
4: [차단] Kick Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec charm) with Spell Lock. In the Hellcaller build, spread Curse of Tongues with Foul Mouth onto both Wasi and Seneschal M'bara to slow their casts (Wowhead).

[해제] When Guard Captain Atu's Captain's Bulwark (nearby mobs take 30% less damage, Magic) lands on the kings, remove it with Devour Magic (Wowhead). Also use Devour Magic on Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending (7% health every 2 sec for 10 sec, Magic) if it gets past the kicks.

[광역 피해] Line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build with the hardest group, King A'akul and the Bloodsworn Assassins (Topicx). If Blood Drain (164870 Physical) comes while Sudden Rupture (18 sec Physical bleed) is on you, activate Unending Resolve, and since warlocks cannot remove bleeds, top yourself up with a Healthstone.
5: [광역 피해] Activate Dark Pact when Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group) lands. If the healer cannot keep up while you back out of the pools, survive with Unending Resolve (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If you use Bloodlust here in high keys (Topicx), line up Summon Infernal and Cataclysm, and in the Hellcaller build hit the nine pulled Embalming Fluids together with Rain of Fire.
6: [차단] Take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole group, 116379 Nature) with Spell Lock (Topicx). Warlocks cannot remove diseases.
[차단] If both cast together, use Blight of Tongues (2 min, 100% longer cast times within 10 yd for 12 sec) to stretch the 4 sec cast to 8 sec and buy time for another kick.
[광역 피해] While a party member is trapped by Entomb, Wail of Mourning (77586 Shadow to the whole group every 2 sec, growing) keeps going. Activate Dark Pact if opening the crypt takes too long.
7: [차단] Take one of the far side Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Spell Lock as well. If a kick is about to be missed, stop both together with Shadowfury (Diabolist) or Howl of Terror (Hellcaller, 35 sec, fears 10 enemies).
[광역 피해] Drop Cataclysm (30 sec, 8 yd) on the eight Embalming Fluids. With Burning Rush on, the 20% slow from Putrid Seekers pools cannot drop you below normal speed.
9: [우선 처치] Kill the two Spectral Shamans first (Topicx). Cast Chaos Bolt on a Shaman, and break any Healing Tide Totem that is already down with Conflagrate. In the Hellcaller build, apply Wither to the Shamans and then press Malevolence.

[차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast Spectral Bolt and Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) nonstop (Topicx). Kick Hex with Spell Lock, and in the Hellcaller build spread Curse of Tongues with Foul Mouth onto both (Wowhead). If both cast together, stop them with Shadowfury (Diabolist) or Howl of Terror (Hellcaller).
[광역 피해] Activate Dark Pact when Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (12 sec Physical) stack up.
10: [우선 처치] In a four-Bloodlust route this pull is the third Bloodlust (Topicx). Line up Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build on the Ghostly Brute and pour Chaos Bolt into it.
[차단] Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Spell Lock, and break Spectral Shaman's Healing Tide Totem with Conflagrate when it appears.
12: [참고] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage goes to whoever engages first (Topicx). Do not open with Summon Infernal or Cataclysm before the tank is in, and use Summon Infernal after the tank has engaged.
[위치] If you are the one soaking the far Pool of Darkness, place Demonic Circle next to that spot beforehand and step in right away with Demonic Circle: Teleport (30 sec) when the pool appears.
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Dark Revelation, use Burning Rush to get more than 20 yd from the group, and activate Unending Resolve for the explosion (473120 Shadow) 5 sec later.

1: [우선 처치] This is the 79-trash pull gathered up to the entrance corridor. Use Summon Infernal (2 min, 1 min 30 sec for Diabolist) and Cataclysm (30 sec), and pour Soul Shards into the CC-immune Primal Juggernaut first with Chaos Bolt (Topicx). In the Hellcaller build, apply Wither to everything and then press Malevolence (1 min).
[차단] The two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a shield that makes allies immune to CC) must be kicked. Take one of them with your Felhunter's Spell Lock (24 sec).

[제어] When the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks get high, stun the Deepstone Earthshapers (Topicx). If the four Earthshapers are together, hold them with Shadowfury (Diabolist, 45 sec, 3 sec stun within 10 yd), and in the Hellcaller build hold one with Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] Activate Dark Pact (45 sec for Diabolist with Frequent Donor, 1 min for Hellcaller) for Primal Juggernaut's Excavating Blast (3.5 sec cast, 106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT).
3: [우선 처치] Defier Draghar is a CC-immune miniboss, and every Steel Barrage strike sends 24246 Fire to the whole group. Line up Summon Infernal on Draghar if it is back, and in the Hellcaller build apply Wither to Draghar and then press Malevolence.
[차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] Activate Dark Pact when the Steel Barrage fire novas stack up, and use Unending Resolve (3 min, 40% less damage taken for 8 sec with Strength of Will) for the next Steel Barrage.
5: [차단] Kicks go to Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) first (Topicx). Take Cinderbolt with Spell Lock.

[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be kicked, so stop it with a stun (Topicx). Stop both together with Shadowfury (Diabolist), and in the Hellcaller build stop it with Mortal Coil or Howl of Terror (35 sec, fears 10 enemies).
[해제] When a Flamelasher dies and channels Blaze of Glory (15 sec channel, Magic), remove it with your Felhunter's Devour Magic (15 sec) to end it (Wowhead).
6: [광역 피해] At 17 and above, Bloodlust goes out at Flamegullet 50% (Topicx). Save Summon Infernal and Malevolence in the Hellcaller build for that moment, and pour Chaos Bolt into Flamegullet to kill it before Molten Blood ramps up.
[광역 피해] When Molten Blood (below 50%, 48491 Fire within 60 yd every 3 sec, 15% more per cast) stacks up, activate Dark Pact and follow with Unending Resolve.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Shadowfury (Diabolist) or Mortal Coil (Hellcaller), and remove its death-channel Blaze of Glory with Devour Magic.
7: [차단] Take one of the two Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Spell Lock, and stop both Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage together with Shadowfury (Diabolist) or Howl of Terror (Hellcaller).

[광역 피해] Activate Dark Pact for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (3 sec cast, 106681 Fire to the whole group plus a stacking 8 sec DoT). If you are targeted by Living Bomb, use Burning Rush to get more than 6 yd from the group.
8: [차단] Take Cinderbolt with Spell Lock, and stop Flaming Barrage with Shadowfury (Diabolist) or Mortal Coil (Hellcaller). Remove Blaze of Glory with Devour Magic.
[참고] A Thunderhead patrols near this pack (Topicx). Do not drop Cataclysm or Rain of Fire on the side the Thunderhead walks through.
10: [광역 피해] When the six Storm Warriors gather, use Summon Infernal and Cataclysm, and spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire in the Hellcaller build and on Chaos Bolt in the Diabolist build.

[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec), activate Dark Pact (Topicx). Dark Pact can be used even while you are under control effects.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Shadowfury (Diabolist) or Mortal Coil (Hellcaller), and remove Blaze of Glory with Devour Magic.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Spell Lock. Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast only targets the tank, so kick it only when you have room.
